name: BGL Trip Costing
query:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(MIN(dtl.log_date), '%%M %%Y') AS "Month::110",
    dtl.branch AS "Site::75",
    dtl.pay_group AS "Pay Group::115",
    dtl.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:105",
    dtl.employee_name AS "Name::150",
    CONCAT(LPAD(DAY(MIN(dtl.log_date)),2,'0'), ' - ', LPAD(DAY(MAX(dtl.log_date)),2,'0')) AS "Dates::80",
    COUNT(DISTINCT dtl.log_date) AS "Days:Int:55",
    dtl.unit AS "Unit::55",
    SUM(dtl.quantity) AS "Qty:Float:70",
    dtl.salary_component AS "Component:Link/Salary Component:165",
    SUM(dtl.amount) AS "Amount:Currency:105"
FROM `tabDaily Trip Log` dtl
WHERE dtl.docstatus = 1
  AND dtl.log_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (%(site)s = 'All' OR dtl.branch = %(site)s)
  AND ( (%(scope)s = 'Unpaid for Payroll' AND dtl.pulled_to_payroll = 0)
     OR %(scope)s = 'All Submitted' )
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(dtl.log_date, '%%Y-%%m'), dtl.employee, dtl.salary_component
ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(dtl.log_date, '%%Y-%%m'), dtl.branch, dtl.pay_group, dtl.employee_name

name: BGL Trips - Yesterday
query:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(dtl.log_date, '%%W, %%d %%M %%Y') AS "Date::170",
    dtl.branch AS "Site::75",
    dtl.pay_group AS "Pay Group::115",
    dtl.employee_name AS "Driver / Operator::160",
    dtl.truck_no AS "Vehicle::80",
    dtl.day_type AS "Day::75",
    dtl.unit AS "Unit::55",
    dtl.quantity AS "Qty:Float:65",
    dtl.rate_applied AS "Rate:Currency:75",
    dtl.amount AS "Amount:Currency:100"
FROM `tabDaily Trip Log` dtl
WHERE dtl.docstatus = 1
  AND dtl.log_date = CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY dtl.branch, dtl.pay_group, dtl.employee_name

name: BGL Leave Balance Board
query: SELECT la.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:110", la.employee_name AS "Name:Data:150", la.leave_type AS "Leave Type:Data:110", SUM(la.total_leaves_allocated) AS "Entitled:Float:75", MAX(IFNULL(app.taken,0)) AS "Taken:Float:65", MAX(IFNULL(pend.pending,0)) AS "Pending:Float:70", (SUM(la.total_leaves_allocated) - MAX(IFNULL(app.taken,0)) - MAX(IFNULL(paid.paid_days,0))) AS "Remaining:Float:80", MAX(IFNULL(req.req_days,0)) AS "Encash Requested:Float:120", MAX(IFNULL(paid.paid_days,0)) AS "Encash Paid:Float:90" FROM `tabLeave Allocation` la LEFT JOIN (SELECT employee, leave_type, SUM(total_leave_days) taken FROM `tabLeave Application` WHERE docstatus=1 AND status='Approved' GROUP BY employee, leave_type) app ON app.employee=la.employee AND app.leave_type=la.leave_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT employee, leave_type, SUM(total_leave_days) pending FROM `tabLeave Application` WHERE docstatus=0 AND status='Open' GROUP BY employee, leave_type) pend ON pend.employee=la.employee AND pend.leave_type=la.leave_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT employee, leave_type, SUM(days) req_days FROM `tabLeave Encashment Request` WHERE status IN ('Requested','Approved') GROUP BY employee, leave_type) req ON req.employee=la.employee AND req.leave_type=la.leave_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT employee, leave_type, SUM(days) paid_days FROM `tabLeave Encashment Request` WHERE status='Paid' GROUP BY employee, leave_type) paid ON paid.employee=la.employee AND paid.leave_type=la.leave_type WHERE la.docstatus=1 AND la.from_date<=CURDATE() AND la.to_date>=CURDATE() GROUP BY la.employee, la.leave_type ORDER BY la.employee_name, la.leave_type

name: Additional Salary Report
query:
SELECT
    IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)') AS "Branch::110",
    ads.department AS "Department::170",
    emp.designation AS "Designation::150",
    ads.employee AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:120",
    ads.employee_name AS "Employee Name::200",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Housing Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Housing:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Transport Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Transport:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Extra Duty Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Extra Duty:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Overtime Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Overtime:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Cubic' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Cubic:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Trips' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Trips:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component NOT IN ('Housing Allowance','Transport Allowance','Extra Duty Allowance','Overtime Allowance','Cubic','Trips') THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Other Allowances:Currency:140",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "TOTAL ALLOWANCES:Currency:150",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component='Salary Advance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Salary Advance:Currency:130",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component='Loans' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Loans:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component IN ('Absent','Absent Days') THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Absent:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component='Damage' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Damage:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component NOT IN ('Salary Advance','Loans','Absent','Absent Days','Damage') THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Other Deductions:Currency:140",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "TOTAL DEDUCTIONS:Currency:150",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' THEN ads.amount END),0)
      - IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "NET ADDITIONAL:Currency:150",

    COUNT(ads.name) AS "Entries:Int:80"

FROM `tabAdditional Salary` ads
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = ads.employee
WHERE ads.company = %(company)s
  AND ads.disabled = 0
  AND ads.payroll_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND ( (%(status)s = 'Draft' AND ads.docstatus = 0)
     OR (%(status)s = 'Submitted' AND ads.docstatus = 1)
     OR (%(status)s = 'Both' AND ads.docstatus IN (0,1)) )
  AND ( %(branch)s = 'All' OR IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)') = %(branch)s )
GROUP BY ads.employee, emp.branch, ads.department, emp.designation, ads.employee_name
HAVING IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' THEN ads.amount END),0) <> 0
    OR IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' THEN ads.amount END),0) <> 0
ORDER BY IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)'), ads.department, ads.employee_name

name: Additional Salary Summary by Branch
query:
SELECT
    IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)') AS "Branch::140",
    COUNT(DISTINCT ads.employee) AS "Employees:Int:110",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Housing Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Housing:Currency:120",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Transport Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Transport:Currency:120",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Extra Duty Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Extra Duty:Currency:120",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Overtime Allowance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Overtime:Currency:120",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Cubic' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Cubic:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component='Trips' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Trips:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' AND ads.salary_component NOT IN ('Housing Allowance','Transport Allowance','Extra Duty Allowance','Overtime Allowance','Cubic','Trips') THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Other Allowances:Currency:150",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "TOTAL ALLOWANCES:Currency:160",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component='Salary Advance' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Salary Advance:Currency:140",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component='Loans' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Loans:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component IN ('Absent','Absent Days') THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Absent:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component='Damage' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Damage:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' AND ads.salary_component NOT IN ('Salary Advance','Loans','Absent','Absent Days','Damage') THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "Other Deductions:Currency:150",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "TOTAL DEDUCTIONS:Currency:160",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' THEN ads.amount END),0)
      - IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' THEN ads.amount END),0) AS "NET ADDITIONAL:Currency:160",

    COUNT(ads.name) AS "Entries:Int:90"

FROM `tabAdditional Salary` ads
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = ads.employee
WHERE ads.company = %(company)s
  AND ads.disabled = 0
  AND ads.payroll_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND ( (%(status)s = 'Draft' AND ads.docstatus = 0)
     OR (%(status)s = 'Submitted' AND ads.docstatus = 1)
     OR (%(status)s = 'Both' AND ads.docstatus IN (0,1)) )
  AND ( %(branch)s = 'All' OR IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)') = %(branch)s )
GROUP BY IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)')
HAVING IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Earning' THEN ads.amount END),0) <> 0
    OR IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ads.type='Deduction' THEN ads.amount END),0) <> 0
ORDER BY IFNULL(emp.branch, '(No Branch)')

name: Payroll Summary Report - Adenta
query:
SELECT
    ss.branch AS "Branch::100",
    ss.designation AS "Staff Designation::170",
    ss.employee_name AS "Full Name::200",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Basic Salary:Currency:120",

    ss.gross_pay
      - IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0)
      - IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component IN ('Overtime Allowance','Cubic','Trips','Marketing Driver OT','Pump Cubic Incentive','Plant Cubic Incentive','Mixer Driver Cubic - Airport','Mixer Driver Cubic - Tema','Cubic - Weekday','Cubic - Weekend') THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Allowance:Currency:120",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component IN ('Overtime Allowance','Cubic','Trips','Marketing Driver OT','Pump Cubic Incentive','Plant Cubic Incentive','Mixer Driver Cubic - Airport','Mixer Driver Cubic - Tema','Cubic - Weekday','Cubic - Weekend') THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Overtime Allowance:Currency:140",

    ss.gross_pay AS "Gross Salary:Currency:130",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='5.5%% SSNIT' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "5.5%% SSNIT:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='PAYE' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "PAYE:Currency:110",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component IN ('Overtime Tax','Overtime Tax - Cubic','Overtime Tax - Trips') THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Overtime Tax:Currency:120",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='Loans' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Loan:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component IN ('Absent','Absent Days') THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Absent:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='Damage' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Damage:Currency:100",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component IN ('Welfare','Provident Fund','Other Deductions') THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Other Deductions:Currency:130",

    ss.net_pay + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='Salary Advance' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Net Pay:Currency:130",
    -IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='Salary Advance' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Salary Advance:Currency:130",
    ss.net_pay AS "Total Salary Payable:Currency:150"

FROM `tabSalary Slip` ss
LEFT JOIN `tabSalary Detail` sd ON sd.parent = ss.name
WHERE ss.docstatus = %(docstatus)s
  AND ss.company = %(company)s
  AND ss.branch = 'Airport'
  AND ss.start_date >= %(from_date)s
  AND ss.end_date <= %(to_date)s
GROUP BY ss.name, ss.branch, ss.designation, ss.employee_name, ss.gross_pay, ss.net_pay
ORDER BY ss.designation, ss.employee_name

name: SSNIT 5.5% & 13% Report
query:
SELECT
    emp.ssnit_number AS "SSNIT Number::130",
    ss.employee AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:110",
    ss.employee_name AS "Full Name::200",
    ss.branch AS "Branch::100",
    ss.designation AS "Staff::160",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Basic Salary:Currency:130",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='5.5%% SSNIT' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Employee 5.5%%:Currency:130",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='SSNIT Employer 13%%' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Employer 13%%:Currency:130",
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='SSNIT 18.5%%' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Total 18.5%%:Currency:130",

    ROUND(
      IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='deductions' AND sd.salary_component='5.5%% SSNIT' THEN sd.amount END),0)
    + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='SSNIT Employer 13%%' THEN sd.amount END),0)
    - IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='SSNIT 18.5%%' THEN sd.amount END),0)
    , 2) AS "Variance:Currency:100"

FROM `tabSalary Slip` ss
INNER JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = ss.employee
LEFT JOIN `tabSalary Detail` sd ON sd.parent = ss.name
WHERE ss.docstatus = %(docstatus)s
  AND ss.company = %(company)s
  AND ss.start_date >= %(from_date)s
  AND ss.end_date <= %(to_date)s
  AND (%(branch)s = 'All' OR ss.branch = %(branch)s)
GROUP BY ss.name, emp.ssnit_number, ss.employee, ss.employee_name, ss.branch, ss.designation
ORDER BY ss.branch, ss.employee_name

name: SSNIT 5% & 13.5% Report
query:
SELECT
    emp.ssnit_number AS "SSNIT Number::130",
    ss.employee AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:110",
    ss.employee_name AS "Full Name::200",
    ss.branch AS "Branch::100",
    ss.designation AS "Staff::160",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Basic Salary:Currency:130",

    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) * 0.135, 2) AS "Tier 1 - 13.5%%:Currency:130",
    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) * 0.05, 2) AS "Tier 2 - 5%%:Currency:130",

    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) * 0.185, 2) AS "Total 18.5%%:Currency:130",

    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='SSNIT 18.5%%' THEN sd.amount END),0) AS "Posted 18.5%%:Currency:130",

    ROUND(
      ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='Basic Salary' THEN sd.amount END),0) * 0.185, 2)
    - IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield='earnings' AND sd.salary_component='SSNIT 18.5%%' THEN sd.amount END),0)
    , 2) AS "Variance:Currency:100"

FROM `tabSalary Slip` ss
INNER JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = ss.employee
LEFT JOIN `tabSalary Detail` sd ON sd.parent = ss.name
WHERE ss.docstatus = %(docstatus)s
  AND ss.company = %(company)s
  AND ss.start_date >= %(from_date)s
  AND ss.end_date <= %(to_date)s
  AND (%(branch)s = 'All' OR ss.branch = %(branch)s)
GROUP BY ss.name, emp.ssnit_number, ss.employee, ss.employee_name, ss.branch, ss.designation
ORDER BY ss.branch, ss.employee_name
